images.name: plus
images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Make a new variant of the supplied Cinna UI arrow icon by changing its symbol only. Preserve the reference's gentle hand-drawn 2D outline, cloud-blue edge, ivory cream fill, thin cocoa contour, and tiny cream highlight. This is a functional UI glyph for 16–24px use: bold silhouette, minimal details, optically centered with generous stroke thickness. One symbol only, isolated on a truly transparent square canvas. No button plate, no circular badge, no background scene, no mascot, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no external glow or large drop shadow. The shape should occupy most of the square without touching its edges. Replace the arrow with one bold addition plus symbol, two smoothly rounded bars of equal length, no enclosing circle.
